title: BEEP! Korean Corpus of Online News Comments for Toxic Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Manual annotation of online entertainment news comments to identify explicit or implicit gender-related biases (including gender roles, sexual orientation, and sexual identity), followed by training and evaluating text classification models (CharCNN, BiLSTM, BERT) on binary and ternary bias detection tasks.

Manual annotation of comments to group various non-gender biases (e.g., race, nationality, political stance, religion, disability, age, appearance, wealth, occupation, military service) into an aggregated 'Other biases' category, evaluated using baseline text classifiers on a ternary bias identification task.
